articles.summary: Rogers Corporation, 3M and Marian are looking at a BESS enclosure gasket and the decisions behind its complete construction, from the sealing material and adhesive to the finished converted part.
articles.title: Designing a BESS Enclosure Seal: Material, Adhesive and Converting Considerations

articles.summary: Enclosure gaps vary, large panels aren't perfectly flat, fasteners pull harder in some areas than others, temperatures change, and the gasket itself can behave differently after years under compression.
articles.title: 6 BESS Enclosure Sealing Considerations for Outdoor Battery Energy Storage Systems
